brief:
The Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement claimed victory after companies withdrew from an Israeli-led natural gas project located off the Gaza coast, according to Al Jazeera English. The departures follow sustained pressure from BDS activists and Palestinian rights groups opposed to the project.

The gas installation sits in disputed waters and remains linked to Israeli operations in the territory, drawing criticism from those backing the boycott campaign.
dek: The Boycott, Divest and Sanctions movement is claiming victory after a company left an Israeli-led gas project off Gaza.
title: Energy firms withdraw from Israeli gas project off Gaza
